reason: A Windows desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness that embeds its local webchat, manages the DSH service, provides tray and diagnostic features, and supports updates and notifications.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供集成本地 Web 聊天、服务管理、系统托盘、日志诊断与任务通知的 Windows 桌面壳。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness that embeds local webchat and provides service management, tray controls, diagnostics, updates, and task notifications.

capabilities: Launches and supervises a local DSH web service
Embeds a localhost webchat interface in a Windows desktop shell
Reads and writes local settings, logs, diagnostic bundles, and application data
Can install or update DSH packages and the desktop plugin with user interaction
Displays system-tray controls and Windows task-completion notifications
Supports file-based image attachments through the embedded chat interface
